content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on the trade list screen, the rowgroup scroll container alternates between scroll_y 225 and scroll_y 0 about every 0.4 to 0.6 s with no click or typing in between, while the pointer stays at the same spot (750,425), which suggests users are repeatedly scrolling down a partial pass and having the list return to the top, so they re-scroll to continue reading rows. In session Scda68eca this starts after the Run overlay is removed (246:x288) and in session Scc8831a1 the same pattern follows the trade list navigation (app:42).", "fix": "Fix: On the trade list screen, in the Scroll container (div role=rowgroup), keep the current scroll offset when the grid re-renders after Run, and make the column header row sticky, so the list does not jump back to the top between partial scroll passes.", "cited_event_ids": ["246:x288", "app:42", "265", "271", "276", "282", "288", "294", "299", "268:319", "278:330", "291:343", "302:355", "304", "311", "316", "323", "328", "335", "340", "307:415", "308:417", "318:429", "320:432", "332:445", "342:458"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["Whether scroll_y returning to 0 is caused by the app (re-render, reset, snap) or by user action; events show only the scroll value, not the cause.", "Row content, row count and column headers are not in the events, so the sticky-header suggestion is unverified.", "Whether the pointer position at (750,425) is a scrollbar or a wheel target is not stated.", "Causal link between the Run overlay and the scroll pattern is temporal only.", "Time lost (median 6.0 s) is taken from the insight facts and not re-derived from the windows."]}
